title: Appeal of Jerguson v. Western Carolina
disposition_detail: The SJC held the appeal judicially out of order under BCO 42-2 because Presbytery was rehearing the case, leaving it unready for higher-court review.
first_summary: The SJC declined to review Jerguson’s appeal while Western Carolina Presbytery was rehearing the case, finding higher-court review premature under BCO 42-2.
summary: The SJC held Jerguson’s appeal judicially out of order under BCO 42-2 because Western Carolina Presbytery was rehearing the case. The matter therefore was not ready for higher-court review. The decision did not reach the merits or dismiss the underlying Presbytery proceedings.
